hints.title: Incident Edges Equation
hints.text: The number of edges incident to pair (u, v) equals degree[u] + degree[v] minus shared edges between u and v.

hints.title: Two Pointers on Sorted Degrees
hints.text: Sort a copy of node degrees. For each query q, use two pointers to count pairs where deg[u] + deg[v] > q.

hints.title: Adjust for Shared Edges
hints.text: Iterate through distinct edges (u, v). If deg[u] + deg[v] > q but deg[u] + deg[v] - shared <= q, decrement count.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(n^2) pairs for every query takes O(q * n^2) which times out for n = 20,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted degree two-pointer sweep plus edge subtraction adjusts answers in O(q * (n + E)) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses two-pointer counting on degree sums before correcting for shared edges.

solutions.approach: Sorted degree two-pointer sweep with shared edge correction
